past_actions.summary: Volunteer two afternoons this week at Millfield Public Library, helping adults with basic computer literacy — email, video calls with family, navigating health insurance portals online.
past_actions.emotional_state: Settled and purposeful, with a low hum of background worry about health and mobility that I keep at arm's length through activity and routine. Not anxious. Not complacent. Something like cautious contentment.

past_actions.summary: Look up RoboRide Inc on the library computers Tuesday afternoon — not to make any decision, but to understand what the service actually involves. How does one summon a vehicle? What is the cost per ride? Is there an app required, and if so, is it the kind of app I can learn? I helped three people set up telehealth accounts last week. I can learn an app.
past_actions.emotional_state: Unsettled in a way I am choosing to treat as interesting rather than alarming. There is genuine unease — the 2am fear is real and I do not want to dismiss it. But there is also, underneath it, something I will cautiously call curiosity. I notice I am more open than I expected to be. I am watching that openness carefully, making sure it is genuine and not just me telling myself a story about being adaptable because I am afraid of being the kind of person who is not adaptable.
